mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expedia_property_content ( property_id, language, active, name, country_code, city, latitude, longitude, star_rating, source_added_at, source_updated_at, fetched_at, raw_sha256, mapping_version, raw_json, normalized_json, evidence_json ) VALUES ( #{propertyId}, #{language}, #{active}, #{name}, #{countryCode}, #{city}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{starRating}, #{sourceAddedAt}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, #{fetchedAt}, #{rawSha256}, #{mappingVersion}, CAST(#{rawJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{normalizedJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{evidenceJson} AS JSON) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active = VALUES(active), name = VALUES(name), country_code = VALUES(country_code), city = VALUES(city), latitude = VALUES(latitude), longitude = VALUES(longitude), star_rating = VALUES(star_rating), source_added_at = VALUES(source_added_at), source_updated_at = VALUES(source_updated_at), fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at), raw_sha256 = VALUES(raw_sha256), mapping_version = VALUES(mapping_version), raw_json = VALUES(raw_json), normalized_json = VALUES(normalized_json), evidence_json = VALUES(evidence_json)
